_comment: `self_accept.js` (read by `a` and `b`) accepts its own updates, and `accept_dep.js` (read by `b` and `c`) accepts updates of `dep.js`. Dev mode inlines both common chunks. Step 0 edits `self_accept.js` and step 1 edits `dep.js`; each update stops at a module printed inside a factory, without a full reload.
